content.text: Investigation complete. Section 18 is the only insurance provision, and it binds the Vendor (Brightline) in our favour. Every preferred element is present, so no redline is warranted.

input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 is a Vendor-side insurance covenant that meets the preferred position in full, so no redline is needed. Clause 18.1 requires Brightline (Vendor) to carry, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward: commercial general liability of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate; workers' compensation as required by law; professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000; and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000. The cyber limit is granted unconditionally rather than only where Vendor processes Customer Data, which is broader than the preferred trigger and favours us — and Vendor does process Customer Data under §§ 15 and 17, so the coverage is squarely engaged. Clause 18.2 supplies the certificate undertaking ("On request, Vendor shall provide certificates of insurance and evidence of relevant coverage"). The clause also adds terms beyond the playbook that benefit us: employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, reputable insurers, primary cover where commercially customary, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities. I searched the whole agreement for any dilution — self-insurance, retentions, "commercially available" qualifiers, or a carve-out overriding § 18 — and found none; § 18 is the only insurance provision. Because the position sits at preferred (not merely fallback), no upgrade or redline is proposed.
